g.title: wc3_project
g.text: Project connects transactions; Linkage connects data

a.xlink:title: Sales proposals — forecasts weighted by probability. Model: apps/transactions/models/proposal.py
Sales orders — customer commitments. Model: apps/transactions/models/order.py
Invoices — shipment and financial events. Model: apps/transactions/models/invoice.py
Purchase orders to vendors. Model: apps/transactions/models/purchase.py
Central identity — customers, vendors, employees. Has related Email, Phone, Address models. Model: apps/contacts/models/contact.py
Attached documents — proposals, photos, videos, meeting notes. Linked via LinkageEntry. Model: apps/docs/models/document.py:22

Product with quantity JSON tracking all inventory buckets. Model: apps/products/models/item.py:196 Functions: Item.quantity @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (JSONField with on_hand, allocated, available, on_p, on_so, on_in, on_po, on_wo, on_r)
Shared line data — specs, related records, data at time of action. Model: apps/core/models/linkage.py
Inventory costing layer — tracks on_hand by receipt cost. Model: apps/products/models/inventory_layer.py

Universal task — who, what, why, when, where, how. References any record. Tracks communication touches. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:10 Functions: Action._pending_attachments @ apps/core/models/action.py:198 (pre_save captures attachment list) Action.post_save (linkage) @ apps/core/models/action.py:230 (creates LinkageEntry group for documents) Action.contact_id resolve @ apps/core/models/action.py:285 (auto-resolves contact from assigned_to)
